full_judgment:
3. Plaint case, in short is that land of the suit holding being Khatian No. 214 was sold in auction for arrears of rent in Rent Execution case No. 1292 of 1919 and one Radha Shashi Gope purchased said land and got delivery of possession through Court and possessed. Subsequently, Radha Shashi Gope transferred 4.80 acres out of 7.03 acres of land to Ishaque, Momtazuddin and Anor Ali by a registered Kabala dated, 9 Sraban 1333 BS and handed over possession, Anor Ali, predecessor-in-interest of contesting defendant No.1 to 10 became owner in possession of 1.60 acres of land in the suit holding. Out of said 1.60 acres, Anor Ali settled 1.20 acres with the plaintiff upon receipt of Salami and a registered Kabuliyat, dated 22 Magh, 1349 BS Anor Ali received rents from the plaintiff. But the suit land was wrongly recorded in RS Khatian No. 395 as a Raiyati Jote instead of Kol Raiyati in the name of the plaintiff under said Anor Ali. 

 6. After death of Anor Ali, defendant No. 1 to 10 started putting various obstacles in the enjoyment of the suit land. Under the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, a holding being SA Khatian No. 331 was however, prepared in the name of both the plaintiff and defendant No.1 to 10 taking advantage of such wrong record of rights, defendant No. 1 to 10 started holding out threat to dispossess the plaintiff from the suit land. Hence, the suit. 

 9. The plaintiff somehow managed to get his name recorded in both RS and SA Khatians No.395 and 331 respectively on a false story that Anor Ali settled the land with him. In title suit No. 471 of 1959 title was declared within full knowledge of the plaintiff. Anor Ali leaving behind defendant No.1 to 10 as his only heirs and legal representatives. Since his death, the defendant possessed the suit land. 

 10. It was also contended that Anor Ali was illiterate and simple man for which he could not get his name mutated in the SA Khatian on the basis of the decree passed in title suit No. 471 of 1969. They got their names mutated in SA Khatian at belated stage on 12-4-1973 with full knowledge of the plaintiff. 

 15. I find in support of this case, the plain-tiff examined three witnesses including him. The defendants also examined three witnesses including defendants No. 4. Plaintiff adduced a certified copy of the Kabuliyat dated 22 Magh, 1349 BS corresponding to 5-2-1943 and also rent receipts which were marked Exhibit-1 and 2 series plaintiff also produced a certified copy of the plaint of title suit No. 471 of 1959, which was marked Exhibit-3. While the defendants adduced the deed dated 9 Srabon 1333 BS in original, Khatian No. 331 and two rents receipt which were marked Exhibit Ka to Ga. 

 16. It is not disputed that land of CS Khatian No. 214 measuring about 7.30 acres was sold in auction for arrears of rent in Rent suit No. 1292 of 1919. One Radha Shashi Gope purchased said land in the auction. Then Radha Rani Gope transferred 4.80 acres out of 7.30 acres to Ishaque, Momtaz and Anor Ali. Anor Ali got 1.60 acres of land and possessed, Anor Ali was survived by defendant No. 1 to 10. 

 17. It is the case of plaintiff that Anor Ali settled 1.20 acres out of his 1.60 acres by a registered Kabuliyat dated 22 Magh, 1349 BS on receipt of salami. The plaintiff since then possessed said land. The suit land was recorded in the name of plaintiff along with the defendants SA Khatian No. 331. Finding their names in the Khatian the defendants tired to dispossess the plaintiff from the suit land. 

 18. Case of the defendant No. 4 to 6 was that the plaintiff somehow managed to get his name recorded in both RS Khatian as well as SA Khatian on false story of settlement. The plaintiff does not possess any land in suit.
